_meta.purpose: Full SIZE x MATERIAL (x COLOUR) production matrix for the Baguette, house-documentation-led. Feeds seed-material-variants-from-production.ts + the bag-page material selector. Per ENFORCED #13: house documentation = the variant was made; absence of a resale listing is never evidence it was not made. Rows with sourced:false are NOT negatives (Fendi did not NOT make them) - they are cells not yet evidenced from a house/reference primary. Load policy is the owner's call per row.
_meta.colour_rule: Fendi does NOT name its colours (descriptors only, per seasonal-archive/fendi.md §3). colour is a plain descriptor or null (cell-level, colour-agnostic).

confidence.high: fendi.com PDP / official Fendi page, or two independent strong references
confidence.medium: one well-sourced reference site / reseller listing / house video, consistent with the beat
confidence.low: single mention or beat knowledge, a lead to verify
confidence.not-yet-sourced: no house/reference primary found this run; NOT a negative

sizes_official.Nano: ~11 x 6.5 x 2.5 cm charm/micro; code prefix 7AS413. Reseller 'Micro' maps here; Rebag 'Pico' is a charm below Nano.
sizes_official.Mini: ~19 x 11.5 x 4 cm small crossbody; code prefix 8BS017. Reseller 'Small' maps here.
sizes_official.Medium: the 1997 original / SATC reference size, ~26-27 x 13-15 x 6 cm; code prefix 8BR600 (the Iconic/Regular Baguette). Reseller 'Large'/'Grande'/'Maxi' = oversized Medium runs, not a clean current fendi.com tier.
sizes_official.ChainMidi: chain-strap FORMAT, medium footprint, H 14.5 cm; code 8BR793 (jacquard). Reseller 'Midi' maps here. The Selleria 'Baguette Soft Trunk' 7VA565 is a related chain/soft-trunk format.
sizes_official.Mamma: the SS2025 soft-nappa drawstring/relaxed reissue, officially titled 'Baguette Soft'; Medium = 26.5 x 18 x 8.5 cm; code prefix 8BR833. Runs in 3 sizes (only Medium directly sourced this run).

_meta.selector_collapse_hint: For the live material selector, collapse to 7-8: Leather (default) | FF / Zucca Canvas (fold FF Jacquard + FF 1974 in, or keep FF Jacquard split) | Selleria | Sequin / Embellished | Raffia | Exotic | Fur / Shearling | Artisan (Hand in Hand). The 10-way split here is the fuller archive matrix.
_meta.style_code_decoder: 8BR600 = Iconic/Medium Baguette base | 8BS017 = Baguette Mini base | 8BR793 = Baguette Chain Midi | 8BR833 = Mamma / Baguette Soft Medium | 7AS413 = Nano Baguette Charm | 7VA565 = Selleria Baguette Soft Trunk (chain format). The 4-char prefix keys the size/line; the tail keys colour/material. GEO-valuable decoder.
_meta.sourcing: 8 firecrawl_search this run (5 refunded 2->1 via feedback, 3 window-expired) = ~11 credits net. All fendi.com facts arrived as clean SEARCH SNIPPETS + PDP titles/descriptions; fendi.com NOT scraped wholesale (Akamai bot-shell risk). No Christie's/Sotheby's Baguette collecting page surfaced.
_meta.under_documented_axis: Per-era size availability (which sizes existed 1997-2010 vs post-2019) is still the thinnest axis from house primaries. Best primary record = the Rizzoli 'Fendi Baguette' book plates + the 'Hand in Hand' book + an owner-present fendi.com archive pass (Chrome, Akamai-walled to Firecrawl).
